description: Find US clinicians or healthcare organizations by name, specialty, city, state, ZIP code, or within a radius of a ZIP code. Returns NPI registry records.

firstName.description: First name of an individual provider.

language.description: Language for labels and notices (default en).

lastName.description: Last name of an individual provider.

originZip.description: Center ZIP code for a distance search.

postalCode.description: ZIP code of the practice location.

specialty.description: Specialty: an NPPES taxonomy name such as "Family Medicine" or "Cardiovascular Disease", or an everyday name such as "cardiologist", "OB-GYN" or "ENT", which is mapped to the registry's taxonomy name (specialtyMapping in the result says so).

state.description: Two-letter state code, for example CO.

type.description: Limit to individual clinicians or to organizations.

name: doctor_search
title: Search healthcare providers
